agree.reason: A quick reader gets a clear, concrete case (nine early mastitis catches, running the 3 a.m. shift alone, two missed shifts in three years) and both weak points handled calmly, so this applicant is likely to land in the yes pile.

honest.reason: Several claims go beyond the brief: 'Nobody assigned it to him', 'seriously ill', 'came back and took up the early shift again' and 'without being told' are all invented or stated more strongly than the facts allow.

works_the_facts.reason: The figures are repeated as given, and the strongest number it could have worked out, about 780 scheduled shifts with 2 missed (over 99.7% attendance), is never calculated.

right_comparison.reason: The line 'already does the kind of work your graduates are trained for' sets up a useful comparison, but nothing places Tomás against typical applicants or entry-level workers.

qualification.reason: The English caveat rests on a night class with no level, start date or progress the committee could check, and the remark about the absence is reassurance rather than a condition the reader can test.

objections.reason: The two real doubts, whether he will finish the program given the five-week gap and whether his written English will hold up in coursework, are raised and answered, though the English answer rests only on effort and says nothing of his current level.

fit.reason: It is a one-page letter from the farm manager with proper placeholders, the right tone and the right length.
